mode.title: Mode
mode.description: video = the URLs/IDs you list. channel = the newest uploads of each handle. reference = probe the surface and report what it yielded (run this first if a result looks wrong).

videos.title: Videos (mode: video)
videos.description: Video IDs or any YouTube link: watch?v=, youtu.be/, /shorts/, /live/, /embed/.

channels.title: Channels (mode: channel)
channels.description: Channel handles such as @mkbhd, or full channel URLs.

videosPerChannel.title: Videos per channel
videosPerChannel.description: How many of each channel's newest uploads to inspect. One request per video.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: Parallel watch-page fetches. Keep this modest: the page is 1.1-1.3 MB and is often served without its payload, so the Actor already retries each video several times.

tlsProfile.title: Preferred TLS profile
tlsProfile.description: Optional. Tried first, then the rest of the ladder. All four answered 200 during recon; this is a tuning knob, not a requirement.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Useful when many videos come back as REDUCED - that is an IP-shaped symptom, so a different exit IP often fixes it.
